entry.title: googleapis/google-cloud-dotnet - Releases - 2025-09-16
entry.content:
Google.Cloud.LocationFinder.V1 version 1.0.0-beta01

New features

  • Initial generation for Google.Cloud.LocationFinder.V1

Google.Cloud.SecurityCenter.V2 version 1.3.0

New features

  • Add GCE to DeploymentPlatform enum

Google.Cloud.Kms.V1 version 3.19.0

New features

  • Support KEY_ENCAPSULATION purpose and quantum-safe algorithms ML_KEM_768, ML_KEM_1024 and KEM_XWING
  • Add PublicKeyFormat enums XWING_RAW_BYTES (used for KEM_XWING) and DER

Google.Cloud.GkeHub.V1 version 2.6.0

New features

  • Add k8s_git_version field

Documentation improvements

  • Correct comment for k8s_version field
  • Reformat comments for several messages, including ListFeaturesRequest, CreateFeatureRequest, and OperationMetadata

Google.Cloud.GkeHub.V1Beta1 version 2.0.0-beta08

New features

  • Add k8s_git_version field

Documentation improvements

  • Correct comment for k8s_version field

Google.Cloud.Eventarc.V1 version 2.7.0

New features

  • Add new fields to Eventarc resources

Documentation improvements

  • Correct some comments
  • Fixed typo in comments in Eventarc protos

Google.Cloud.Dlp.V2 version 4.20.0

New features

  • Add LocationSupport,Domain,DocumentFallbackLocation

Documentation improvements

  • Minor doc revision

Google.Cloud.DiscoveryEngine.V1Beta version 1.0.0-beta20

New features

  • Added ranking_expression_backed and rank_signals fields related to the Custom Ranking feature

Documentation improvements

  • A comment for field ranking_expression in messages .google.cloud.discoveryengine.v1alpha.SearchRequest and .google.cloud.discoveryengine.v1beta.SearchRequest is changed to support the Custom Ranking use case

Google.Cloud.DiscoveryEngine.V1 version 1.10.0

New features

  • Added ranking_expression_backed and rank_signals fields related to the Custom Ranking feature

Documentation improvements

  • A comment for field ranking_expression in messages .google.cloud.discoveryengine.v1alpha.SearchRequest and .google.cloud.discoveryengine.v1beta.SearchRequest is changed to support the Custom Ranking use case
